rag.name: integral_sin_pow_even
rag.content:
theorem integral_sin_pow_even :
    (∫ x in (0)..π, sin x ^ (2 * n)) = π * ∏ i ∈ range n, (2 * (i : ℝ) + 1) / (2 * i + 2) := by
  induction' n with k ih; · simp
  rw [prod_range_succ_comm, mul_left_comm, ← ih, mul_succ, integral_sin_pow]
  norm_cast
  simp [-cast_add, field_simps]

rag.name: integral_sin_pow_pos
rag.content:
theorem integral_sin_pow_pos : 0 < ∫ x in (0)..π, sin x ^ n := by
  rcases even_or_odd' n with ⟨k, rfl | rfl⟩ <;>
  simp only [integral_sin_pow_even, integral_sin_pow_odd] <;>
  refine mul_pos (by norm_num [pi_pos]) (prod_pos fun n _ => div_pos ?_ ?_) <;>
  norm_cast <;>
  omega

rag.name: integral_exp_mul_complex
rag.content:
theorem integral_exp_mul_complex {c : ℂ} (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    (∫ x in a..b, Complex.exp (c * x)) = (Complex.exp (c * b) - Complex.exp (c * a)) / c := by
  have D : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => Complex.exp (c * y) / c) (Complex.exp (c * x)) x := by
    intro x
    conv => congr
    rw [← mul_div_cancel_right₀ (Complex.exp (c * x)) hc]
    apply ((Complex.hasDerivAt_exp _).comp x _).div_const c
    simpa only [mul_one] using ((hasDerivAt_id (x : ℂ)).const_mul _).comp_ofReal
  rw [integral_deriv_eq_sub' _ (funext fun x => (D x).deriv) fun x _ => (D x).differentiableAt]
  · ring
  · fun_prop

open Complex ComplexConjugate MeasureTheory Bornology Set Complex.Set
informal_statement: The integral of the function \( e^{i n x} \) from 0 to \( 2\pi \) equals zero for any non-zero integer \( n \).
informal_proof:
We consider the integral of \( e^{i n x} \) from 0 to \( 2\pi \). When \( n \) is a non-zero integer, this integral equals zero. This follows from properties of complex exponential functions over full periods.

To see why, we apply the lemma: the integral of \( e^{i n x} \) over one full period \( 0 \) to \( 2\pi \) is zero when \( n \neq 0 \), as the positive and negative areas cancel out due to the oscillatory nature of the exponential function. Hence, the integral evaluates to zero.

C1_dependencies.name: Complex.exp_eq_one_iff
C1_dependencies.content:
theorem exp_eq_one_iff {x : ℂ} : exp x = 1 ↔ ∃ n : ℤ, x = n * (2 * π * I) := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases existsUnique_add_zsmul_mem_Ioc Real.two_pi_pos x.im (-π) with ⟨n, hn, -⟩
    use -n
    rw [Int.cast_neg, neg_mul, eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero]
    have : (x + n * (2 * π * I)).im ∈ Set.Ioc (-π) π := by simpa [two_mul, mul_add] using hn
    rw [← log_exp this.1 this.2, exp_periodic.int_mul n, h, log_one]
  · rintro ⟨n, rfl⟩
    exact (exp_periodic.int_mul n).eq.trans exp_zero
